items.tradition: Small Seal (小篆), modern vector redraw
items.caption: A modern redraw of 半 in the Shuowen Lesser Seal tradition. The reported analysis reads 八 above 牛; this illustration represents the received seal-script form, not an ancient artifact.
items.alt: Modern vector drawing of 半 in a Shuowen Lesser Seal style.
items.selection_reason: The exact Commons description page identifies this as a Shuowen Jiezi Lesser Seal radical drawing and records CC BY-SA 3.0; the Academia Sinica entry independently labels a Small Seal form for 半. It illustrates a supported form tradition, while remaining explicitly identified as a modern redraw.
